welcomeTagline.message: Instant English ↔ 18-language lookups, powered by WordReference.com.

welcomeStep1Body.message: Pick the language you want English translated to — Spanish, French, German, Turkish, and 14 others — on the settings page.

welcomeStep2Intro.message: Four ways to reach a translation, whichever fits your flow:

welcomeShortcutAltZ.message: Open the dictionary popup. Type or paste any word.

welcomeShortcutAltX.message: Select text on any web page, then press to show an in-page translation bubble.

welcomeShortcutAltQ.message: Same as Alt + X — an alternate binding for keyboard layouts where Alt + X is taken.

welcomeShortcutAltDblClick.message: Hold Alt and double-click a word to translate it right where it sits.

welcomeShortcutRightClick.message: Select a word, right-click, then choose WordReference: '…' to open the full result in a new tab.

welcomeStep3Body.message: Star any word from the popup or in-page bubble to add it to your favorites. Manage and export the list to Excel from the settings page — perfect for vocabulary review.

welcomeDisclaimer.message: Not affiliated with or endorsed by WordReference.com.

pdfViewerHint.message: Alt + double-click · Alt + X · Alt + Q to look up a word

optionsHowToTrigger.message: Select a word and use Alt + double-click, Alt+Q (page shortcut), or Alt+X (Chrome command shortcut).

optionsFavoritesIntro.message: Save favorites from the popup or in-page bubble. Favorites are stored locally on this device only.

optionsPdfToggleHelp.message: Lets you use Alt + double-click, Alt + X, and Alt + Q to look up words inside PDF files. Renders PDFs locally with Mozilla PDF.js — no document content leaves your browser.
